<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>GLOBAL CUSTODY AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left">This agreement, dated January&nbsp;13,
2026 (the &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;), is between <B>JPMORGAN CHASE BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION </B>(&ldquo;J.P. Morgan&rdquo;), with a place
of business at 383 Madison Ave., New York NY 10017; and the entities listed in Schedule 1 hereto (each a &ldquo;Customer&rdquo;) with
a place of business at 660 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York 10103. J.P. Morgan and each Customer have executed this Agreement in the
form of a master agreement for administrative convenience only and, except as expressly provided in this Agreement, this Agreement shall
create a separate Agreement between J.P. Morgan and each Customer as though J.P. Morgan had executed a separate Agreement with that Customer.
No rights, responsibilities or Liabilities of any Customer shall be attributed to any other Customer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>1.</B></TD><TD><B>INTENTION OF THE PARTIES; DEFINITIONS</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>1.1</B></TD><TD><B>Intention of the Parties</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>This Agreement sets out the terms on which J.P. Morgan will provide custodial, settlement, asset
                                 servicing and other associated services to the Customer. J.P. Morgan will be responsible for the performance
                                 of only those duties expressly set forth in this Agreement. The Customer acknowledges that J.P. Morgan
                                 is not providing any legal, tax or investment advice in connection with the services under this Agreement.
                                 The terms and conditions of this Agreement are applicable only to the services which are specified in
                                 this Agreement.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>1.2</B></TD><TD><B>Definitions; Interpretation</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Definitions</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify">As used herein, the following
terms have the meanings hereinafter stated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Account&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set forth in
Section&nbsp;2.1(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Account Assets&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set
forth in Section&nbsp;4.3(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Affiliated Subcustodian Bank</B>&rdquo; means
a Subcustodian that is both a subsidiary of JPMorgan Chase&nbsp;&amp; Co. and either (i)&nbsp;a bank chartered or incorporated in the
United States of America or (ii)&nbsp;a branch or subsidiary of such a bank.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Agreement&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set forth
in the Preamble.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;AML/Sanctions Requirements&rdquo; </B>means (a)&nbsp;any
Applicable Law (including but not limited to the rules&nbsp;and regulations of the United States Office of Foreign Assets Control) applicable
to J.P. Morgan, or to any J.P. Morgan Affiliate engaged in servicing any Account, which governs (i)&nbsp;money laundering, the financing
of terrorism, insider dealing or other unlawful activities, or the use of financial institutions to facilitate such activities or (ii)&nbsp;transactions
involving individuals or institutions which have been prohibited by, or are subject to, sanctions of any governmental authority; and
(b)&nbsp;any J.P. Morgan policies and procedures reasonably designed to assure compliance with any such Applicable Law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Applicable Law&rdquo; </B>means any applicable
statute, treaty, rule, regulation or law (including common law) and any applicable decree, injunction, judgment, order, formal interpretation
or ruling issued by a court or governmental entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Authorized Person&rdquo; </B>means any person
who has been designated by written notice from the Customer in the form as provided by J.P. Morgan (or by written notice in the form
as provided by J.P. Morgan from any agent designated by the Customer, including an investment manager) to act on behalf of the Customer
under this Agreement, any person who has received a User Code from Customer, or any person authorized by Customer to receive a User Code
from J.P. Morgan. Such persons will continue to be Authorized Persons until such time as J.P. Morgan receives and has had reasonable
time to act upon Instructions from the Customer (or its agent) that any such person is no longer an Authorized Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>AutoCredit</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth
in Section&nbsp;2.6(c).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Bank Receivership</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Cash Account&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set forth
in Section&nbsp;2.1(a)(ii).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Change</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth in

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Change Request</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set
forth in Section&nbsp;2.17(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>CLS Bank</B>&rdquo; means CLS Bank International,
or any other subsidiary of CLS Group Holdings AG and, in each case, any successor thereto and/or in each case any subsidiary thereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>CLS Services</B>&rdquo; means the provision of
continuous linked settlement currency exchange services by J.P. Morgan, a participant of CLS Bank.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Confidential Information&rdquo; </B>means all
non-public information concerning the Customer or the Accounts which J.P. Morgan receives in the course of providing services under this
Agreement. Nevertheless, the term Confidential Information does not include (i)&nbsp;information that is or becomes available to the
general public other than as a direct result of J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s breach of the terms of this Agreement, (ii)&nbsp;information that
J.P. Morgan develops independently without using the Customer&rsquo;s confidential information, (iii)&nbsp;information that J.P. Morgan
obtains on a non-confidential basis from a person who is not known to be subject to any obligation of confidence to the Customer with
respect to that information, or (iv)&nbsp;information that the Customer has designated as non-confidential or consented to be disclosed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Control Account Assets</B>&rdquo; has the meaning
set forth in Section&nbsp;6.1(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Corporate Action&rdquo; </B>means any subscription
right, bonus issue, stock repurchase plan, redemption, exchange, tender offer, or similar matter with respect to a Financial Asset in
the Securities Account that requires discretionary action by the beneficial owner of the Financial Asset, but does not include rights
with respect to class action litigation or proxy voting.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Counterparty</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth
in Section&nbsp;2.1(c).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Country Risk&rdquo; </B>means the risk of investing
or holding assets in a particular country or market, including, but not limited to, risks arising from nationalization, expropriation,
capital controls, currency restrictions or other governmental actions; the country&rsquo;s financial infrastructure, including prevailing
custody, tax and settlement practices; laws applicable to the safekeeping and recovery of Financial Assets and cash held in custody;
the regulation of the banking and securities industries, including changes in market rules; currency devaluations or fluctuations; and
market conditions affecting the orderly execution of securities transactions or the value of assets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Country Risk Event&rdquo; </B>means an event which
occurs as a result of Country Risk.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Customer&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set forth
in the Preamble.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Dormant Account</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set
forth in Section&nbsp;2.1(d).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Entitlement Holder&rdquo; </B>means the person
named on the records of a Securities Intermediary as the person having a Security Entitlement against the Securities Intermediary.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>FDIC</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth in Section&nbsp;6.5(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Financial Asset&rdquo; </B>means a Security and
refers, as the context requires, either to the Security itself or to the means by which a person&rsquo;s claim to the Security is evidenced,
including a Security certificate or a Security Entitlement. The term &ldquo;Financial Asset&rdquo; does not include cash.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 48%">Global Custody Agreement &ndash; New York &ndash; October 2024</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 4%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->2<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 48%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2621272d1_ex10-7img02.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Identifying Information</B>&rdquo; has the meaning
set forth in Section&nbsp;6.9(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Information</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set forth
in Section&nbsp;2.11(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Information Provider&rdquo; </B>means any person
(including a J.P. Morgan Affiliate) who provides software, information or the means of obtaining information on security prices, derivative
prices, security characteristics data, market data, foreign exchange, credit ratings, performance measurement or any other information
obtained by J.P. Morgan in connection with the Services (including index return providers, security characteristics providers, and value-at-risk
providers).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>&ldquo;Instruction&rdquo;
</B>means an instruction, whether or not in fact authorized, that has been verified in accordance with the Security Procedure or, if
no Security Procedure is applicable, that J.P. Morgan believes in good faith to have been given by an Authorized Person.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>&ldquo;J.P.
Morgan&rdquo; </B>has the meaning set forth in the Preamble.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;J.P. Morgan Affiliate&rdquo; </B>means an entity
controlling, controlled by, or under common control with J.P. Morgan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;J.P. Morgan Indemnitees</B>&rdquo; means J.P.
Morgan, J.P. Morgan Affiliates, Subcustodians, and their respective nominees, directors, officers, employees and agents.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Liabilities&rdquo; </B>means any liabilities,
losses, claims, costs, damages, penalties, fines, obligations, taxes (other than taxes based solely on a party&rsquo;s own income), or
expenses of any kind whatsoever (whether actual or contingent and including, without limitation, attorneys&rsquo;, accountants&rsquo;,
consultants&rsquo; and experts&rsquo; fees and disbursements reasonably incurred and for the avoidance of doubt, with respect to any
Liabilities owed by the Customer, Liabilities shall also include any and all amounts owing to J.P. Morgan by the Customer&rsquo;s counterparty
in connection with collateral Accounts or control Accounts established at J.P. Morgan pursuant to the Customer&rsquo;s Instruction) and
outstanding from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>Proxy Voting Service</B>&rdquo; has the meaning
set forth in Section&nbsp;2.10(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Reports&rdquo; </B>means the reports, information
or data provided by J.P. Morgan in connection with the provision of the Services.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Securities&rdquo; </B>means shares, stocks, debentures,
bonds, notes or other like obligations, whether issued in certificated or uncertificated form, and any certificates, receipts, warrants
or other instruments representing rights to receive, purchase or subscribe for the same that are commonly traded or dealt in on securities
exchanges or financial markets and any other property as may be acceptable to J.P. Morgan for the Securities Account.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Securities Account&rdquo; </B>has the meaning
set forth in Section&nbsp;2.1(a)(i).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Securities Depository&rdquo; </B>means any securities
depository, clearing corporation, dematerialized book entry system or similar system for the central handling of Securities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Security Entitlement&rdquo; </B>means the rights
and property interests of an Entitlement Holder with respect to a Financial Asset as set forth in Part&nbsp;5 of Article&nbsp;8 of the
Uniform Commercial Code of the State of New York, as the same may be amended from time to time.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-left: 0.5in; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: left"><B>&ldquo;Securities
Intermediary&rdquo; </B>means J.P. Morgan, a Subcustodian, a Securities Depository and any other financial institution which in the ordinary
course of business maintains Securities custody accounts for others and acts in that capacity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2621272d1_ex10-7img02.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Security Procedure</B>&rdquo; means the applicable
security procedure to be followed by the Customer (and its Authorized Persons) and/or by J.P. Morgan, so as to enable J.P. Morgan to
verify that an instruction is authorized. The applicable Security Procedure for different types of instructions may be set forth in service
level documentation in effect from time to time with respect to the services set forth in this Agreement or in separate documentation,
and may be updated by J.P. Morgan from time to time upon notice to the Customer. A Security Procedure may, without limitation, involve
the use of User Codes, dual-factor authentication, telephone call backs, or third party utilities. For the avoidance of doubt, an authenticated
SWIFT message issued in the name of the Customer through any third party utility that J.P. Morgan has approved as a utility through which
Instructions may be provided hereunder shall be deemed to have been verified through a Security Procedure.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Services&rdquo; </B>means the services provided
under this Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;Subcustodian&rdquo; </B>means any of the subcustodians
appointed by J.P. Morgan from time to time to hold Financial Assets and act on its behalf in different jurisdictions and includes any
Affiliated Subcustodian Bank. In no event will an entity that is a Securities Depository, whether or not acting in that capacity, be
deemed to be a Subcustodian. For the avoidance of doubt, the transfer agent of a Financial Asset shall not be deemed to be a Subcustodian
with respect to that Financial Asset.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>USA PATRIOT Act</B>&rdquo; has the meaning set
forth in Section&nbsp;6.9(a).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in"><B>&ldquo;User Code&rdquo; </B>means a password digital
certificate, identifier (including biometric identifier), security device, algorithm, encryption or other similar procedure used by the
Customer or an Authorized Person to access J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s systems, applications or products or to issue Instructions to J.P. Morgan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 0.5in">&ldquo;<B>U.S. Special Resolution Regime</B>&rdquo; has
the meaning set forth in Section&nbsp;10.2.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.</B></TD><TD><B>WHAT J.P. MORGAN IS REQUIRED TO DO</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.1</B></TD><TD><B>Set Up Accounts</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will establish and maintain the following accounts (&ldquo;Accounts&rdquo;):</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>one or more accounts in the name of the Customer (or in another name
                                            requested by the Customer that is acceptable to J.P. Morgan) to which Financial Assets are
                                            or may be credited (each a &ldquo;Securities Account&rdquo;), which may be held by J.P. Morgan,
                                            a Subcustodian or a Securities Depository for J.P. Morgan on behalf of the Customer, including
                                            as an Entitlement Holder; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>one or more cash accounts in the name of the Customer (each, a &ldquo;Cash
                                            Account&rdquo;) (or in another name requested by the Customer that is acceptable to J.P.
                                            Morgan) for any and all cash in any currency received by or on behalf of J.P. Morgan for
                                            the account of the Customer.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>At the request of the Customer, additional Accounts may be opened in the future, and such additional
                                 Accounts shall be subject to the terms of this Agreement.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>In the event that the Customer requests the opening of any additional Account for the purpose of
                                 holding collateral pledged by the Customer to a securities exchange, clearing corporation, or other
                                 central counterparty (a &ldquo;Counterparty&rdquo;) to secure trading activity by the Customer, or the
                                 pledge to a Counterparty of cash or individual Securities held in an Account, that Account (or the pledged
                                 cash or Securities) shall be subject to the collateral arrangements in effect between J.P. Morgan and
                                 the Counterparty in addition to the terms of this Agreement.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD>Upon not less than thirty (30) days&rsquo; prior notice to the Customer, J.P. Morgan may close any
                                 Account for which J.P. Morgan has not received any Instructions for at least one (1)&nbsp;year or which
                                 J.P. Morgan otherwise reasonably determines to be dormant (each a &ldquo;Dormant Account&rdquo;). J.P.
                                 Morgan may, upon closure of a Dormant Account, move any Account Assets in that Account into another
                                 Account of the Customer and, in the case of a cash payment, J.P. Morgan is authorized to enter into
                                 any foreign exchange transactions with the Customer needed to facilitate the payment, as contemplated
                                 by Section&nbsp;2.15.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s obligation to open Accounts pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.1(a)&nbsp;is conditional
                                 upon J.P. Morgan receiving such of the following documents as J.P. Morgan may require:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>a certified copy of the Customer&rsquo;s constitutional documents as in
                                            force at the time of receipt;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>evidence reasonably satisfactory to J.P. Morgan of the due authorization
                                            and execution of this Agreement by the Customer (for example by a certified copy of a resolution
                                            of the Customer&rsquo;s board of directors or equivalent governing body);</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD>in cases where the Customer designates an investment manager, evidence
                                            reasonably satisfactory to J.P. Morgan of that appointment as an Authorized Person and of
                                            the officers and employees of the investment manager authorized to act with respect to the
                                            relevant Account;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iv)</TD><TD>information about the Customer&rsquo;s financial condition, such
                                            as its audited and unaudited financial statements; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2621272d1_ex10-7img02.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(v)</TD><TD>in the case of any Account opened in a name other than that of the
                                            Customer, documentation with respect to that name similar to that set forth in paragraphs
                                            (i)&nbsp;&ndash; (iv).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.2</B></TD><TD><B>Deposit of Cash</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Any cash in any currency received by or on behalf of J.P. Morgan for the account of the Customer
                                 will be either:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>deposited in one or more Cash Accounts at J.P. Morgan in New York
                                            or at one of its non-U.S. branch offices and will constitute a debt owing to the Customer
                                            by J.P. Morgan as banker, provided that (A)&nbsp;any cash so deposited with a non-U.S. branch
                                            office will be payable exclusively by that branch office in the applicable currency, subject
                                            to compliance with Applicable Law, including, without limitation, any applicable currency
                                            restrictions and (B)&nbsp;while J.P. Morgan is not required to pay or charge interest on
                                            any such Cash Account, J.P. Morgan may, from time to time, in its discretion, pay interest
                                            on any such Cash Account (or charge interest if, at the time, the prevailing interest rate
                                            in the relevant market for similar deposits in the same currency is negative) at a rate to
                                            be determined by J.P. Morgan; or</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>deposited in an account maintained in the name of the Customer at
                                            the Subcustodian in the relevant market, in which case the deposit will constitute a debt
                                            owing to the Customer by that Subcustodian as the Customer&rsquo;s banker and not by J.P.
                                            Morgan, payable exclusively in the applicable currency at that Subcustodian; for the avoidance
                                            of doubt, cash held in that account will not be part of the Cash Account(s). A list of markets
                                            for which this Section&nbsp;2.2(a)(ii)&nbsp;applies will be made available on J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s
                                            website.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>Any amounts credited by J.P. Morgan to the Cash Account on the basis of a notice or a provisional
                                 credit from a third party, may be reversed if J.P. Morgan does not receive final payment in a timely
                                 manner. J.P. Morgan will notify the Customer promptly of any such reversal.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will make amounts deposited into a Cash Account held in the United States available
                                 in accordance with its availability policy, the current version of which is attached hereto as Annex
                                 B.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.3</B></TD><TD><B>Segregation and Registration of Assets; Nominee Name</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will identify in its books that those Financial Assets credited to the Customer&rsquo;s
                                 Securities Account belong to the Customer (except as may be otherwise agreed by J.P. Morgan and the
                                 Customer).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>To the extent permitted by Applicable Law, J.P. Morgan will require each Subcustodian to identify
                                 that Financial Assets held at such Subcustodian by J.P. Morgan on behalf of its customers belong to
                                 customers of J.P. Morgan, by means of differently titled accounts on the books of the Subcustodian or
                                 other equivalent measures that achieve the same level of protection.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan is authorized, in its discretion to:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>hold in bearer form such Financial Assets as are customarily held
                                            in bearer form or are delivered to J.P. Morgan or its Subcustodian in bearer form;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>hold Financial Assets in or deposit Financial Assets with any Securities
                                            Depository;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD>hold Financial Assets in omnibus accounts on a fungible basis and
                                            accept delivery of Financial Assets of the same class and denomination as those deposited
                                            by the Customer;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iv)</TD><TD>register in the name of the Customer, J.P. Morgan, a Subcustodian,
                                            a Securities Depository or their respective nominees, such Financial Assets as are customarily
                                            held in registered form, provided that J.P. Morgan shall, on an ongoing basis, make available
                                            accurate information to the Customer and such other persons as the Customer may designate
                                            with respect to the registration or location of the Customer&rsquo;s Financial Assets; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(v)</TD><TD>decline to accept any asset or property which it deems to be unsuitable
                                            or inconsistent with its custodial operations.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD>For the avoidance of doubt, unless J.P. Morgan has provided prior written approval, the Customer
                                 may not instruct a third party to register any Financial Asset in the name of J.P. Morgan, a Subcustodian,
                                 a Securities Depository or any of their respective nominees. The Customer agrees that any Financial
                                 Asset registered in the name of J.P. Morgan, a Subcustodian, a Securities Depository or any of their
                                 respective nominees without J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s authorization shall not be considered to be held in
                                 custody under this Agreement.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.4</B></TD><TD><B>Settlement of Transactions</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Subject to Section&nbsp;3 and Section&nbsp;4.2, J.P. Morgan will act in accordance with Instructions
                                 with respect to settlement of transactions. Settlement of transactions will be conducted in accordance
                                 with prevailing standards of the market in which the transaction occurs. Without limiting the generality
                                 of the foregoing, the Customer authorizes J.P. Morgan to deliver Financial Assets or cash payment in
                                 accordance with applicable market practice in advance of receipt or settlement of consideration expected
                                 in connection with such delivery or payment, and the Customer acknowledges and agrees that such action
                                 alone will not of itself constitute negligence, fraud, or willful misconduct of J.P. Morgan, and the
                                 risk of loss arising from any such action will be borne by the Customer. If the Customer&rsquo;s counterparty
                                 (or other appropriate party) fails to deliver the expected consideration as agreed, J.P. Morgan will
                                 notify the Customer of such failure. If the Customer&rsquo;s counterparty continues to fail to deliver
                                 the expected consideration, J.P. Morgan will provide information reasonably requested by the Customer
                                 that J.P. Morgan has in its possession to allow the Customer to enforce its rights against the Customer&rsquo;s
                                 counterparty, but neither J.P. Morgan nor its Subcustodians will be obliged to institute legal proceedings,
                                 file a proof of claim in any insolvency proceeding or take any similar action.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>Except to the extent J.P. Morgan and the Customer have agreed to treat settlement of a transaction
                                 under the contractual settlement date accounting basis set forth in Section&nbsp;2.5, J.P. Morgan will
                                 post such transaction on the date on which the cash or Financial Assets received as consideration for
                                 the transaction is actually received and settled by J.P. Morgan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan reserves the right to reverse any transactions that are credited to the Accounts due
                                 to mis-postings, errors and other similar actions.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2621272d1_ex10-7img02.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.5</B></TD><TD><B>Contractual Settlement Date Accounting</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>In cases where J.P. Morgan and the Customer agree to do so, and subject to the other provisions
                                 of this Section&nbsp;2.5, J.P. Morgan will effect book entries on a contractual settlement date accounting
                                 basis as described below with respect to the settlement for those Financial Assets and transactions
                                 as to which J.P. Morgan customarily offers contractual settlement date accounting.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>Sales: On the settlement date for a sale, J.P. Morgan will credit
                                            the Cash Account with the proceeds of the sale and post the Securities Account as pending
                                            delivery of the relevant Financial Assets.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>Purchases: On the settlement date for a purchase (or earlier, if
                                            market practice requires delivery of the purchase price before the settlement date), J.P.
                                            Morgan will debit the Cash Account for the settlement amount and will then post the Securities
                                            Account as awaiting receipt of the expected Financial Assets. The Customer will not be entitled
                                            to the delivery of Financial Assets until J.P. Morgan or a Subcustodian actually receives
                                            them.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan may reverse any book entries made pursuant to Section&nbsp;2.5(a)&nbsp;prior to a transaction&rsquo;s
                                 actual settlement upon notice to the Customer if J.P. Morgan reasonably believes that the transaction
                                 will not settle in the ordinary course within a reasonable time. The Customer will be responsible for
                                 any Liabilities resulting from such reversal. The Customer acknowledges that the procedures described
                                 in Section&nbsp;2.5 are of an administrative nature, and J.P. Morgan does not undertake to make loans
                                 of cash and/or Financial Assets to the Customer.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will make available on its website a list of the markets for which it provides contractual
                                 settlement date accounting. J.P. Morgan may add markets to or remove markets from the contractual settlement
                                 date accounting service upon notice to the Customer that is reasonable under the circumstances. Additionally,
                                 J.P. Morgan reserves the right to restrict in good faith the availability of contractual settlement
                                 date accounting for credit or operational reasons, either for individual Financial Assets, types of
                                 Financial Assets, counterparties or markets, or overall.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.6</B></TD><TD><B>Income Collection (AutoCredit&reg;)</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will monitor information publicly available in the applicable market about forthcoming
                                 income payments on the Financial Assets held in the Securities Account, and will promptly notify the
                                 Customer of such information.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>Except in cases where J.P. Morgan agrees to offer the AutoCredit service described in paragraph
                                 (c)&nbsp;of this Section&nbsp;2.6, J.P. Morgan shall not be required to credit income on Financial Assets,
                                 net of any taxes withheld by J.P. Morgan or any third party, prior to actual receipt and reconciliation
                                 by J.P. Morgan.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>In cases where J.P. Morgan agrees to provide the following service, J.P. Morgan will credit the
                                 Cash Account with the anticipated income proceeds on Financial Assets on the anticipated payment date,
                                 net of any taxes that are withheld by J.P. Morgan or any third party (such service hereinafter defined
                                 as &ldquo;AutoCredit&rdquo;) for those Financial Assets and/or markets for which J.P. Morgan customarily
                                 offers an AutoCredit service. J.P. Morgan may reverse AutoCredit credits upon notice to the Customer
                                 if J.P. Morgan believes that the corresponding payment will not be received by J.P. Morgan within a
                                 reasonable period of time or the credit was incorrect. J.P. Morgan will make available on its website
                                 a list of the markets for which it provides AutoCredit. J.P. Morgan may add markets to or remove markets
                                 from the AutoCredit service upon notice to the Customer that is reasonable under the circumstances.
                                 Additionally, J.P. Morgan reserves the right to restrict in good faith the availability of AutoCredit
                                 for credit or operational reasons, either for individual Financial Assets, types of Financial Assets,
                                 counterparties or markets, or overall.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 48%">Global Custody Agreement &ndash; New York &ndash; October 2024</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 4%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->8<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: right; width: 48%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE><P STYLE="margin: 0pt"></P></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2621272d1_ex10-7img02.jpg" ALT=""></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will use reasonable efforts to contact appropriate parties to collect unpaid interest,
                                 dividends or redemption proceeds and notify the Customer of the late payment; however, neither J.P.
                                 Morgan nor its Subcustodians will be obliged to institute legal proceedings, file a proof of claim in
                                 any insolvency proceeding or take any similar action.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.7</B></TD><TD><B>Miscellaneous Administrative Duties</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>Until J.P. Morgan receives Instructions to the contrary, J.P. Morgan will:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>present all Financial Assets for which J.P. Morgan has received written
                                            notice of a call for redemption or that have otherwise matured, and all income and interest
                                            coupons and other income items that call for payment upon presentation;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>execute in the name of the Customer such certificates as may be required
                                            to obtain payment in respect of Financial Assets; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD>exchange interim or temporary documents of title held in the Securities
                                            Account for definitive documents of title.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>In the event that, as a result of holding Financial Assets in an omnibus account, the Customer receives
                                 fractional interests in Financial Assets arising out of a corporate action or class action litigation,
                                 J.P. Morgan will credit the Customer with the amount of cash the Customer would have received, as reasonably
                                 determined by J.P. Morgan, had the Financial Assets not been held in an omnibus account, and the Customer
                                 shall relinquish to J.P. Morgan its interest in such fractional interests.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD>If some, but not all, of an outstanding class of Financial Assets is called for redemption, J.P.
                                 Morgan will allot the amount redeemed among J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s global custody customers who are the
                                 respective beneficial holders of such a class of Financial Assets in a manner that J.P. Morgan deems
                                 to be fair and equitable.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.8</B></TD><TD><B>Corporate Actions</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will act in accordance with local market practice to obtain information concerning Corporate
                                 Actions that is publicly available in the local market. J.P. Morgan also will review information obtained
                                 from sources to which J.P. Morgan subscribes for information concerning such Corporate Actions. J.P.
                                 Morgan will promptly provide that information (or summaries that reflect the material points concerning
                                 the applicable Corporate Action) to the Customer or its Authorized Person.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will act in accordance with the Customer&rsquo;s Instructions in relation to such Corporate
                                 Actions. If the Customer fails to provide J.P. Morgan with timely Instructions with respect to any Corporate
                                 Action, neither J.P. Morgan nor its Subcustodians or their respective nominees will take any action
                                 in relation to that Corporate Action, except as otherwise agreed in writing by J.P. Morgan and the Customer
                                 or as may be set forth by J.P. Morgan as a default action in the notification it provides under Section&nbsp;2.8(a)&nbsp;with
                                 respect to that Corporate Action.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.9</B></TD><TD><B>Securities Litigation Services</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Any notices received by J.P.
Morgan&rsquo;s corporate actions department about a settled securities litigation that requires action by affected owners of the underlying
Financial Assets will be promptly notified to the Customer if J.P. Morgan, using reasonable care and diligence in the circumstances,
identifies that the Customer held the relevant Financial Assets in custody with J.P. Morgan at the relevant time. J.P. Morgan will not
make filings in the name of the Customer in respect to such notifications except as otherwise agreed in writing between the Customer
and J.P. Morgan. The services set forth in this Section&nbsp;2.9 are available only in certain markets, details of which are available
from J.P. Morgan on request.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.10</B></TD><TD><B>Proxies</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>With respect to U.S. Financial Assets and, in cases where the Customer elects to subscribe to the
                                 service described in this Section&nbsp;2.10, other Financial Assets, J.P. Morgan will monitor information
                                 distributed to holders of Financial Assets about upcoming shareholder meetings, promptly notify the
                                 Customer of such information and, subject to Section&nbsp;2.10(c), act in accordance with the Customer&rsquo;s
                                 Instructions in relation to such meetings (the &ldquo;Proxy Voting Service&rdquo;).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>The Proxy Voting Service is available only in certain markets and for certain types of Financial
                                 Assets, details of which are available from J.P. Morgan on request. Provision of the Proxy Voting Service
                                 is conditional upon receipt by J.P. Morgan of a duly completed enrollment form as well as all documentation
                                 that may be required for certain markets.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 35.85pt">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Proxy Voting Service does not include physical attendance at shareholder
                                   meetings. Requests for physical attendance at shareholder meetings can be made but they will be evaluated
                                   and agreed to by J.P. Morgan on a case by case basis.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD>The Customer acknowledges that the provision of the Proxy Voting Service may be precluded or restricted
                                 under a variety of circumstances. These circumstances include, but are not limited to:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD>the Financial Assets being on loan or out for registration;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(ii)</TD><TD>the pendency of conversion or another corporate action;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iii)</TD><TD>the Financial Assets being held in a margin or collateral account
                                            at J.P. Morgan or another bank or broker, pledged to a Counterparty, or otherwise in a manner
                                            which affects voting;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(iv)</TD><TD>local law or market practices, or restrictions by the issuer; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(v)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan being required to vote all shares held for a particular
                                            issue for all of J.P. Morgan&rsquo;s customers on a uniform basis (i.e., a &ldquo;yes&rdquo;
                                            or &ldquo;no&rdquo; vote for the total position based on net voting instructions received
                                            from all its customers). Where this is the case, J.P. Morgan will notify the Customer.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>2.11</B></TD><TD><B>Statements of Account</B></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD>J.P. Morgan will provide the Customer with electronic access to Account information (the &ldquo;Information&rdquo;)
                                 that will enable the Customer to generate or receive reports and statements of account for each Account
                                 and to identify Account Assets as well as Account transactions. The Customer will review the Information
                                 and give J.P. Morgan written notice of (i)&nbsp;any suspected error or omission or (ii)&nbsp;the Customer&rsquo;s
                                 inability to access any such Information. The Customer will provide J.P. Morgan such notice within a
                                 reasonable time after (x)&nbsp;the Information is made available to the Customer or (y)&nbsp;the Customer
                                 discovers that it is unable to access the Information, as the case may be.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD>The Customer acknowledges that Information available to it electronically with respect to transactions
                                 posted after the close of the prior business day may not be accurate due to mis-postings, delays in
                                 updating Account records, and other causes. J.P. Morgan will not be liable for any Liabilities arising
                                 out of any such information accessed electronically that is subsequently updated or corrected by the
                                 close of business on the first business day after the original transaction was posted.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
